layer1.name: Oratio
layer1.one_liner: A platform for businesses to run customer support through chat messengers.
layer1.description: Let small businesses handle customer conversations across messaging apps from one inbox, with chatbot automation for common questions. Built during the period when messaging platforms were opening to third-party bots.
layer1.outcome_note: Closed as the founder's third startup. The postmortem, 'From hero to zero', describes building into a hyped category whose promised platform distribution did not materialise.
